Cheek 0.1.1 improves fragmented downloads and fixes compatibility and performance issues.

- Download static DASH fragment lists supplied by yt-dlp in parallel, including initialization fragments, relative URLs and segment query parameters. Video and audio share the connection limit; fragments are assembled in order without re-encoding.
- Reuse the full response when a server ignores Range, avoiding a second download request. Reuse the connection from successful range probes.
- Buffer file writes, honor small host chunk limits, cancel HTTP workers with their parent download and fail promptly on permanent fragment errors.
- Fix yt-dlp's `%(field).NB` output templates and merging Opus audio into MP4.

Use `-N 8` to allow eight requests across streams. HLS and DASH fragment duration comes from the source; `--chunk-size` controls byte ranges for direct files. HTTP byte-range downloads resume; fragment downloads restart. Live, encrypted and byte-range DASH fragments remain unsupported.

Includes binaries for Linux, Windows, macOS and all three Android ABIs used by Hamstr. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
